DraftKings Launches Nationwide "Gameday" Push Ahead of NFL Kickoff

Published September 2, 2026 · 4 min read · By the OddsLighthouse Editorial Team

DraftKings ran a one-day, nationwide promotional event called "DraftKings Gameday" on September 2, timed to the start of the 2026 NFL season. The company describes it as its first coast-to-coast activation combining its sportsbook, predictions, and casino products under a single campaign, part of a broader push to market its "Super App" ahead of what is typically the highest-traffic stretch of the year for US sports betting operators.

Free gas in five cities, plus a celebrity campaign

The centerpiece of the day was free gas giveaways in five cities — Atlanta, Dallas, Los Angeles, Miami, and Detroit — alongside interactive fan experiences, special guest appearances, and various in-app offers across DraftKings' sportsbook, predictions, and casino platforms. The promotion rides alongside a new ad campaign titled "Take Your Game Anywhere," featuring Kevin Hart and Nick Jonas on a road trip. DraftKings also tied a $50,000 charitable donation to Disabled American Veterans to the campaign.

A download stat aimed squarely at a rival

DraftKings used the announcement to highlight a competitive data point: the company says its app downloads are up roughly 25% compared to the same period last year, a stretch in which it says rival FanDuel's downloads declined by nearly 50%. Independent, third-party verification of those exact figures wasn't part of the company's release, but the comparison signals how directly DraftKings is positioning this campaign against FanDuel heading into the season that historically drives the largest swings in US sportsbook market share.

Why it matters to bettors

A marketing campaign doesn't change the odds or the underlying product on the app, but the scale of this one — a coordinated national push spanning three product lines right as the NFL season begins — underscores how much operators are now leaning on football season to cross-sell prediction markets and casino products to sportsbook users, not just acquire new bettors. Anyone comparing sportsbooks this fall should still evaluate the actual lines, features, and terms on offer rather than the marketing around them; see our sports betting guides for how to shop lines across operators.
